programme.title: Unforgettable
programme.desc: Carries berufliches und privates Leben treffen zusammen als ihr Freund, der Sohn eines Mafiabosses, mit Verdächtigen in einem Mordfall in Zusammenhang gebracht wird.

programme.title: Unforgettable
programme.desc: Als der 20-jährige Stahlbauarbeiter Chris Feeney ermordet auf einer Baustelle gefunden wird, beharrt Projektleiter Bob Spence sofort felsenfest darauf, dass dieser Mord nichts mit einer Serie von Diebstählen zu tun hat, die in letzter Zeit bei dem Bauunternehmen vorgefallen sind. Während Al und Carrie in verschiedene Richtungen ermitteln, wird auf der Baustelle erneut eine Person ermordet.

programme.title: Unforgettable
programme.desc: Im Studentenwohnheim wird die Leiche des jungen Miles gefunden. Er war ein schüchterner Junge, der unbedingt in einer Studentenverbindung aufgenommen werden wollte. Doch die Bruderschaft lehnte ihn ab, und Miles revanchierte sich mit einem veröffentlichten Video, das die brutalen Aufnahmerituale der Bruderschaft zeigt.

programme.title: Unforgettable
programme.desc: Ein Anrufer kündigt Carrie einen Mord an und verweist auf einen anderen, der bereits passiert ist. In der Hoffnung, die zweite Tat zu verhindern, rast das Team los, nur um mitzuerleben, wie ein Passant auf offener Straße von einem Scharfschützen erschossen wird. Zunächst scheint zwischen den beiden Taten kein Zusammenhang zu bestehen, aber ein dritter Anschlag weist auf eine Verbindung hin, die 20 Jahre zurückliegt. Kennt Carrie den Anrufer aus ihrer Vergangenheit?

programme.title: Unforgettable
programme.desc: Al ist als Nebenkläger der Staatsanwaltschaft gegen Jo Hagan vor Gericht. Dieser wird beschuldigt, bei einem Bootsausflug seine Frau über Bord geworfen zu haben. Da in dem Kaff des Angeklagten aber alle zusammenhalten, springt ein Zeuge nach dem anderen ab und hält lieber den Mund. Eine junge Frau, Kate Jordan, lässt sich allerdings nicht abhalten und ist mutig genug, gegen Hagan auszusagen. Doch kurz nachdem Kate auf City Island angekommen ist, verschwindet sie ...

programme.title: Unforgettable
programme.desc: In einem Chemielabor explodiert eine Bombe und eine junge Frau stirbt. Die Spur führt zu einer Aktivisten- Gruppe und schließlich zu einer ominösen Figur namens Faraday. Al und Carrie stoßen auf eine Karte, auf der noch vier weitere Ziele verzeichnet sind.

programme.title: Unforgettable
programme.desc: Gaststar Andrew McCarthy spielt Ari Sonnenland, einen wohlhabenden Bauunternehmer, dessen 11jährige Tochter entführt wurde. Der reiche Geschäftsmann hat genug Geld, um das Lösegeld zu zahlen, will aber das NYPD nicht einschalten, und bittet Carrie und Al um Hilfe bei der Lösung des Falls.

programme.title: Unforgettable

programme.desc: Argentina and France in the match of the centuries explained.

programme.title: Joe Dreck 2: Beautiful Loser
programme.desc: In dieser Fortsetzung des Kultfilms Joe Dreck von 2001 spielt David Spade wieder den glücklosen Rock ‘n' Roll-Fan und White-Trash-Helden mit der Vokuhila-Frisur. Diesmal führt ihn seine epische Reise durch die jüngere Vergangenheit, das Herz von Amerika und durch seinen eigenen Verstand, um zurück zu seinen Lieben zu kommen.

programme.title: Walk Hard: The Dewey Cox Story
programme.desc: WALK HARD erzählt die urkomische Geschichte der bewegten Karriere von Musiklegende Dewey Cox: Rock 'n' Roll ist sein Leben. Er schläft mit 411 Frauen, heiratet dreimal, hat 22 Kinder und 14 Stiefkinder, ist der Star seiner eigenen 1970er Jahre Fernsehshow, zählt von Elvis über die Beatles bis hin zu einem Schimpansen alle möglichen Leute zu seinen Freunden und zieht sich jede Droge rein, die der Menschheit bekannt ist, ehe er versucht, von ihr wieder loszukommen … Doch trotz allem – oder gerade deswegen?! – wird Cox zu einem nationalen Idol und findet in seiner Backup-Sängerin Darlene die große Liebe seines Lebens.

programme.title: Peggy Sue hat geheiratet
programme.desc: Was würden Sie anders machen, wenn Sie die Möglichkeit hätten, Ihr Leben noch einmal zu leben? In Francis Ford Coppolas gefeierter Romantikkomödie bekommt Peggy Sue (Kathleen Turner) die Chance, dieser Frage auf den Grund zu gehen. Mit Joan Allen, Nicolas Cage, Helen Hunt und Jim Carrey in weiteren Hauptrollen ist 'Peggy Sue hat geheiratet' eine humorvolle, anrührende Fantasiegeschichte über die goldene Chance, die sich jeder schon mindestens einmal im Leben gewünscht hat.

programme.title: Fools Rush In - Herz über Kopf
programme.desc: Alex Whitman (Matthew Perry) ist ein sittenstrenger Geschäftsmann aus Manhattan und Isabel Fuentes (Salma Hayek) eine feurige, mexikanisch-stämmige Amerikanerin, die an die Macht des Schicksals glaubt. Keiner dachte darüber nach, wohin eine einzige leidenschaftliche Nacht führen könnte, aber die Launen des Zufalls hatten andere Pläne. Als sie sich drei Monate später wiedersehen, ist sie schwanger, und sie beschließen, zu heiraten. Es ist ein weiter Weg von Manhattan nach Las Vegas, aber Alex findet bald, dass es die Reise wert war. Fools Rush In erzählt die lustige, romantische Geschichte zweier durchs Schicksal zusammengeführter Liebenden, die sich am ältesten Spiel der Welt versuchen: Liebe. Columbia Pictures zeigt Matthew Perry (NBCs Friends) und Salma Hayek (From Dusk Til Dawn, Desperado) in Fools Rush In, einer Geschichte über die Funken, die fliegen, wenn zwei Welten aufeinandertreffen. Produziert hat den Film Doug Draizin (Spy Hard), die Regie führte Andy Tennant (It Takes Two) nach einem Drehbuch von Katherine Reback, das auf der Story von Joan Taylor & Katherine Reback basiert. Anna Maria Davis ist Koproduzentin und Michael McDonnell (The Usual Suspects) der ausführende Produzent. In den weiteren Hauptrollen sind Jon Tenney, Jill Clayburgh, Tomas Milian, John Bennett Perry, Siobhan Fallon und Carlos Gomez zu sehen. Robbie Greenberg, ASC ist der Kameramann und Edward Pisoni der Szenenbildner. Der Schnitt des Films erfolgte von Roger Bondelli, A.C.E. Kimberly Tillman ist die Kostümbildnerin.

programme.title: Drinking Buddies - Erwachsen werden ist schwer
programme.desc: Luke (Jake Johnson) und Kate (Olivia Wilde) arbeiten zusammen in einer Bier-Brauerei in Chicago, wo sie den Tag über Bier trinken und wie soll es auch anders sein, miteinander flirten

programme.title: Roxanne
programme.desc: Ein Feuerwehrmann mit Seltenheitswert: Wortgewandt, belesen und sensibel. Und eine Nase, so lang, dass sie die Umwelt nur so in Staunen versetzt. Doch blöde Bemerkungen läßt sich Feuerwehrhauptmann C.D. Bales (Steve Martin) nicht gefallen. Er weiß sich zu wehren: Er hat zwar eine lange Nase, doch ist er dafür nicht auf den Mund gefallen. Außerdem schwingt er seinen Tennisschläger wie einen Degen, falls ihm jemand zu nahe kommt. Aus der Fassung bringt C.D. erst die schöne Astronomin Roxanne (Daryl Hannah). Aus Angst sich zu blamieren, wenn er ihr seine Gefühle gesteht, verschanzt er sich hinter glühenden Liebesbriefen, die er für seinen schüchternen, doch von Roxanne favorisierten Kollegen Chris (Rick Rossovich) schreibt. Doch als der bei Roxanne dann die Früchte der glühenden Umwerbung erntet, wird"s C.D. - Nase oder nicht - zuviel.

programme.title: Zwei wahnsinnig starke Typen
programme.desc: Wilder und Pryor sind arbeitslos und ohne einen Penny. Sie kehren dem Broadway den Rücken zu und machen sich auf nach Süden, um Freiheit und Glück zu finden. Mit völlig leeren Taschen bleibt nur eins: sie müssen unterwegs arbeiten. Der Job, für eine Bank als komische Vögel verkleidet, Kunden anzulocken, scheint die Rettung. Aber - vom Pech verfolgt - stehlen Bankräuber ihre Kostüme und rauben so, unerkannt, die Bank aus. Dreimal dürfen Sie raten, wer dafür ins Kittchen wandert. Nach diesem furiosen Auftakt folgt ein zwerchfellerschütterndes Abenteuer dem anderen.

programme.title: Seems Like Old Times
programme.desc: Der Schriftsteller Nick wird von zwei Gaunern gezwungen, eine Bank zu überfallen. Vom Gesetz verfolgt, hat Nick keine Chance unterzutauchen, außer bei seiner Ex-Frau Glenda. Doch ihr Haus ist voll mit Hunden, ihre Küche mit illegalen Immigranten. Aber das eigentliche Problem ist, Nick vor ihrem neuen Ehemann zu verstecken, denn: Er ist der Bezirks-Staatsanwalt!

programme.title: Deathly Weapon
programme.desc: Der hoffnungslos spielsüchtige Matt (Steven Seagal) ist ein in Ungnade gefallener Cop mit einer Million Dollar Schulden. Als eine geheime Regierungsorganisation diskret seine Schuldscheine aufkauft, soll Matt eine Reihe mächtiger Krimineller, die dank ihres Reichtums und Einflusses über dem Gesetz stehen, finden und eliminieren. Als er sich jedoch weigert, einen korrupten Cop zu töten, den er irrtümlicherweise für sauber hält, sieht Matt sich dazu gezwungen, seinen Weg aus einer Situation freizuschießen, in der er nicht gewinnen kann und jede Bewegung seine letzte sein könnte.

programme.title: Anacondas: Trail of Blood
programme.desc: Der todgeweihte Magnat Murdoch (Emmy®-Kandidat John Rhys-Davies) beauftragt einen Arzt, einen neuen Bestand Blutorchideen zu ernten und mit ihrem regenerativen Nektar Experimente an einer kleinen Anaconda durchzuführen. Über Nacht wächst die Babyschlange zu einem Monster heran, das groß und hungrig genug ist, um den guten Doktor zu verspeisen, bevor es sich frisch gestärkt auf einen Amoklauf begibt. Die attraktive Forscherin Amanda (Crystal Allen) ist entschlossen, die gefährlichen Tiere zu töten, an deren Entstehung sie selbst beteiligt war, und führt ein Team junger Wissenschaftler gegen Murdochs eiskalte Bande bewaffneter Schläger an, um die begehrten Orchideen in Sicherheit zu bringen, bevor die gefährliche Schlange beide Parteien erwischt. Das angriffslustige Reptil scheint unbesiegbar, gleitet unbeschadet durch Explosionen und Feuergefechte und regeneriert sich jedes Mal aufs Neue, um unersättlich alles zu verzehren, was sich ihm in den Weg stellt.

programme.title: The Art of War 2: Der Verrat
programme.desc: Als Agent Neil Shaw (Wesley Snipes) sich aus seinem Versteck hervorwagt, um den Mord an seinem ehemaligen Mentor zu rächen, stößt er auf eine Spur aus Verrat und tödlicher Korruption. Unter dem Schutz seines Freundes, eines Senatorenkandidaten, soll er die Wahrheit aufdecken. Als jedoch immer mehr Menschen getötet werden, muss Shaw einsehen, dass er in eine Falle gelockt wurde. Nun lässt er seinen Fäusten freien Lauf, um eine Verschwörung und ein Attentat aufzuklären, als deren Drahtzieher er verdächtigt wird. Höchste Zeit, die Politik ein wenig unter Druck zu setzen und die atemberaubende Action des Martial Arts-Meisters zu genießen!

programme.title: Stone Cold - Eiskalt
programme.desc: Selleck spielt den ehemaligen Detective Jesse Stone, der L.A. und seine Exfrau hinter sich gelassen hat, um Police Chief in dem verschlafenen neuenglischen Fischerort Paradise, Massachusetts, zu werden. Allerdings tut Stone sich schwer, alte Gewohnheiten abzulegen, und so frönt er weiterhin seinen beiden Lieblingsaktivitäten - dem Scotch und den Frauen. Als sich die Mordfälle in dem sonst so friedlichen Küstenort häufen und eine Highschool-Schülerin vergewaltigt wird, muss er den eigenen Dämonen ins Auge blicken, um die Verbrechen aufzuklären.

programme.title: First Shot: Das Attentat
programme.desc: Als in einem Offiziersclub ein Bombenanschlag zahlreiche Menschenleben fordert, will US-Präsident Jonathan Hayes trotz der Warnungen seiner Sicherheitsberaterin Alex McGregor am Trauerzeremoniell teilnehmen. Noch während seiner Rede wird er angeschossen und schwer verletzt. Alex und ihr freund Grant Coleman heften sich an die Spur der Attentäter – und bringen sich damit selbst in höchste Gefahr.

programme.title: Drunken Master - The Beginning
programme.desc: Won Fei Hung (Jackie Chan) ist der übermütige Sohn eines Martial Arts-Meisters, der ständig irgendwelche neuen Streiche ausheckt, statt sich der hohen Kunst des Kung Fu zu widmen. Nachdem der Sohn eines mächtigen Mannes im Dorf durch einen seiner Scherze verletzt wird, bittet sein Vater einen sadistischen Onkel, dem missratenen Sprössling endlich ein wenig Disziplin einzutrichtern. Dieser Fremde, der Gerüchten zufolge seine Schüler auch schon mal zu Krüppeln macht, bringt Fei Hung eine besonders seltene Kung Fu-Technik bei. Zunächst wehrt sich Fei Hung, doch nachdem er im Kampf gegen den Auftragskiller, der seinen Vater töten soll, unterliegt, sieht er ein, dass er den „Drunken Boxer“-Stil um jeden Preis erlernen muss.

programme.title: Die Abenteuer Von Tim Und Struppi - Das Geheimnis Der Einhorn
programme.desc: Der allseits beliebte junge Reporter Tim und sein treu ergebener Hund Struppi - klassische Figuren ihres Schöpfers Hergé - erwachen im internationalen Filmhit „Die Abenteuer von Tim und Struppi” zum Leben. Nach dem Kauf eines Schiffsmodells mit brisantem Inhalt, geraten Tim und seine Freunde ins Visier eines teuflischen Schurken. Erst auf hoher See, dann in der Wüste Nordafrikas: Jede Wendung beschert dem Zuschauer mehr Nervenkitzel, Spannung und Abenteuer für die ganze Familie.

programme.title: Ladder 49
programme.desc: Ein Feuerwehrmann, der in einem Feuer gefangen ist, das ihn wahrscheinlich töten wird, nutzt die Gelegenheit, um auf sein Leben, seine Karriere und seine Ehe zurückzublicken, während er darauf wartet, dass seine Kompanie, Ladder 49, ihn rettet, sofern sie es schaffen.

programme.title: Miss Bala (2019)
programme.desc: Gloria (Gina Rodriguez) fährt nach Tijuana, Mexiko, um ihre beste Freundin zu besuchen, die am hiesigen Schönheitswettbewerb 'Miss Bala' teilnimmt. Während eines nächtlichen Party-Trips wird ihre Freundin entführt, und Gloria wird zur Schachfigur in einem gefährlichen Spiel der CIA, der Drogenbehörde und eines charismatischen, aber kaltblütigen Kartell-Kings. Indem sie eine Kraft in sich findet, von der sie nichts geahnt hatte, spielt Gloria eine Organisation gegen die andere aus und versucht, ihre Freundin zu retten. Um zu überleben, muss sie all ihre Gerissenheit, Erfindungsgabe und Stärke aufbringen.Dieser packende Actionthriller wird als 'eine bahnbrechende Story für eine neue Art von Actionheld' gefeiert (Peter Debruge, Variety).

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including multiple Emmy, Peabody and Edward R. Murrow Awards.

programme.title: CBS Weekend News
programme.desc: Journalist Adriana Diaz anchors the Saturday edition of the CBS news program from Chicago, while Jericka Duncan takes the helm of the Sunday broadcast from New York. The two are the latest to fill the roll of weekend anchor, which was most recently represented by Reena Ninan and Eliane Quijano. The program offers the latest headlines, original reporting and in-depth pieces that add context and perspective to the world's events.

programme.title: 60 Minutes
programme.desc: The oldest and most-watched newsmagazine on television gets the real story on America's most prevalent issues. CBS News correspondents contribute segments to each hourlong episode. Topics range from hard news coverage to politics, lifestyle, pop culture, business, health, and science. The correspondents and contributors include Lesley Stahl, Scott Pelley, Anderson Cooper, Bill Whitaker, Sharyn Alfonsi, Jon Wertheim and Norah O'Donnell .

programme.title: New Rock And Metal Videos For You
programme.desc: Stay ahead of the curve with the freshest drops from the global underground. From world premieres to the latest studio masterpieces, we’ve gathered the newest sonic assaults in one place. If it’s loud and new, it’s here.

programme.title: Together We Rise
programme.desc: A tribute to the global brotherhood that refuses to fit in. This collection celebrates the unity that turns fans into a tribe. In this pit, no one stands alone—together, we are the loudest force on earth.

programme.title: Endless Heavyness
programme.desc: Dive into pure power and unrelenting energy. Endless Heavyness is a non-stop wall of sound designed to hit hard and stay loud. No pauses, no compromises—just the most massive tracks to keep the momentum going. It’s not just loud; it’s eternal.

programme.title: Where Heavy Music Lives
programme.desc: Your official gateway to the underground. Discover your first distorted riff or find a circle of peers who "get it." Welcome to the neighborhood—it’s loud, it’s proud, and there’s always room for one more.

programme.title: Metal That Rocks
programme.desc: Where rock 'n' roll swagger meets the weight of metal. This collection bridges the gap, featuring everything from anthemic hard rock to core-shaking classics. It’s loud, it’s proud, and it’s built to move you.

programme.title: Lobsters - The Knights Of The Deep
programme.desc: The knights of the deep are on the move; almost no part of their bodies is without armor. Like medieval warriors, these fighters are well armed – not with sword and shield, but with scissors and forceps and defensive armor that is covered with spikes and hooks. And even though they are well protected and have an uncanny awareness of their surroundings, many of these proud knights will face a gloomy destiny. Many of them will end upon a plate. Gourmets all over the world are in love with these famous crustaceans: lobsters! For marine biologists lobsters are similarly fascinating: as research objects. We are on their trail in Cape Breton, an island in the northern Atlantic and part of the Canadian province Nova Scotia, where one of the largest populations of lobsters has its home.

programme.title: Mantises - Masters of Deception
programme.desc: They are killers. They kill with unbelievable precision. They fight Kung Fu style and are seen in Japan as a symbol of vigilance - the mantises. Their triangular head with its unique flexibility is conspicuous. Two overdimensioned eyes fixate the distance to their prey rapidly and three-dimensionally. The chest segment of the mantis is prolonged and equipped with spiny appendages that can spear their prey as fast as a jack knife. The mysterious aura that surrounds the praying mantis has a lot to do with the fact that they are rarely seen. They have adapted to their surroundings perfectly. No matter whether leaves, blossoms, tree bark, sandy floors or even orchids - the mantis adjusts to all environments.

programme.title: Predators of a Different Kind - In the World of the Unknown Sharks
programme.desc: With the aid of modern technology, reveal the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts. Our film trip begins on the Bahamas. To be more precise: in the turquoise-blue waters of the Grand Bahama Bank, in an exactly fixed location. In the spring, 70 – 80 pregnant lemon sharks arrive here. This huge shark population was first discovered just a few years ago by shark researcher, Professor Sam Gruber. Many of the females are tired and rest on the seabed. Pregnant tiger sharks swim in the midst of this group. Without any protection whatsoever, our cameramen shoot their footage, surrounded by sharks and succeed in capturing images hitherto unseen. We continue our journey to Gainesville, Florida, to meet Gordon Hubbell, the leading shark denture expert with the world’s largest shark denture collection. He knows everything about the evolutionary history of the lemon sharks, in addition to those of the white-tip reef variety off Cocos Island, Costa Rica. Here, we encounter large schools of fish, unprecedented numbers of stingrays, as well as hammerhead sharks. However, it is the white-tip reek sharks that make the biggest impression. Their performance begins late at night. Marauding, they patrol in large groups through the reefs and hunt everything that moves. Scales and dead prey fish float above the reef – a welcoming change of diet for the ubiquitous barracudas.

programme.title: mareTV: Majorca
programme.desc: "Cleaning woman island", concrete castles, Ballermann: Mallorca's image is negatively affected in some respects. The documentary explores the charm of the largest Balearic island beyond the hustle and bustle of tourism and Rambazamba. The "real" Mallorca is best explored through real Majorcans: Manolo Barahona, TV fishing expert from the local island broadcaster IB3, faces the most difficult task of the year. The Raor is in season, the most expensive fish on the island. Manolo is supposed to get him first in front of the camera and then in the pan. There's only one catch, the little fish with the piranha teeth just doesn't want to be on TV. In the first months of the year Mallorca turns into a sea of almond blossoms. There are around seven million almond trees on the island, once planted to replace dead vines. But now also the almond trees are threatened. The fire bacterium continues to spread, especially on the large plantations. The farmer Biel Torrens wants to save Mallorca's almond trees and fruit with a small organic plantation and gentle harvesting methods. He shakes the almonds from the tree by hand instead of using a mechanical vibrator.

programme.title: Menorca - Majorca's beautiful sister
programme.desc: Not nearly as crowded as Majorca or Ibiza: Menorca has noticeably fewer visitors than her sister islands and in 1993, was recognised by UNESCO as a biosphere re-serve. Menorca also has its own distinctive charm, with its secluded coves, mighty cliffs, beautiful gardens and ages old towns and villages. Its residents love the is-lands treasures and peculiarities. Forests make up al-most a third of Menorca, complemented by many lush green meadows. Next to tourism, agriculture is a major source of the island's income to the present day. On Menorca, there are several accumulations of enormous megalithic stones. From a global point of view, the up to five-metre-tall "Taulas", whereby the stones are ar-ranged in the shape of a "T", are unique.

programme.title: mareTV: Ibiza - Island of Light
programme.desc: The light of the Balearic island of Ibiza is magical and its trademark: The "Island of Light" is tiny compared to its sister island Mallorca, but offers the most beautiful sunsets in the world. That's what they say. They attract sun worshippers and party people from near and far. To the sounds of the famous "Balearic Sound" they turn night into day. This documentary documents the island in the balancing act between luxury yachts and traditions. Hippie culture, celebrities, pine forests, bays with turquoise water and villages with bright white houses: Ibiza has many faces. Mora (80) and Djin (67) have been drawn to the island for 55 years. They are the uncrowned kings of the hippies. But only love, light, air and laziness, these times are also long gone on Ibiza. Mora knits sexy jerseys for young hippies from morning till night. Djin helps her sell at the famous Las Dalias hippie market and works as a construction worker: chilling and no pension in sight. The virgin Carmen is the patron saint of the sailors. On her day of honour, a mass is celebrated in the port city of Eivissa. Afterwards, fishermen carry the Virgin through the narrow streets of Ibiza City down to the quay. And then Carmen sets sail. Several places on Ibiza claim to offer the most beautiful sunset in the world: In front of Cala de Benirrás, the sun sinks right next to the iconic rock Cap Benat, which the locals awefully call "God's Finger". The typical soft beats over the sea sound from almost all the bays and provide deep relaxation worldwide under the term "Balearic Sound". Some of the famous DJs are jetting around the globe for huge fees. But in the small beach bars, the Chiringuitos, the island sound is celebrated further. On the beach of Cala Salada the Brit Joe Burnley has the command over a troop of mermaids. The ladies squeeze into the tight mermaid costume for the good cause. With great grace they swim towards yachts that are forbidden to anchor on sea grass meadows. Charming but unyielding, they point out the offence to the captain and crew; a creative environmental action to save the endangered Neptune gas, green lung of the sea and habitat for Ibiza's seahorses. The underwater photographer Manu San Felix is also committed to the endangered seahorses. Using a probe, he maps the coastal area around Ibiza and feeds the data into a GPS app. No skipper should be able to say that he didn't even know that his anchor was clawing into Neptune grass. On land, Manu is dedicated to breeding seahorses. His plan: He wants to expose the animals in the Mediterranean to Ibiza and Formentera in order to secure their population. Garages on the beach? Many bays on the island still have Casetas Varadero, boat garages threatened with decay. Fishermen once built them illegally. The picturesque sheds are therefore only tolerated, but may no longer be restored. The 83-year-old Toni Salvado still drives straight out to sea from his garage. He fishes for his own needs and a few friends, he is not allowed to sell his catch.

programme.title: Fuerteventura: The golden beauty of the Canaries
programme.desc: Fuerteventura, the second largest of the Canary Islands, is located just 120 kilometres off the coast of West Africa. The climate is extremely dry and the struggle for water has always been a major setback. Then, around a century ago, returning US emigrants brought what were then modern wind turbine water pumps from the Aermotor Windmill Company with them to Fuerte-ventura. Today, the environmentally friendly and so-called “Chicago’s”, experience a renaissance. Unfortu-nately, original spare parts in good condition are diffi-cult to come by. When Leocadio Araya Sanchez began planting countless cacti on a barren hillside a few years ago, people thought he was mad. His idea was to make a healthy juice drink from the prickly pears – with great success. But getting the fruit to release its pre-cious superfood juice is no simple task. On an almost daily basis, Marcos Tapia is magnetically attracted to one of the paradisiacal beaches of the island. The 44-year-old is Spanish champion and vice world champion in para-body board surfing. When he was 28. Marcos was involved in a serious motorbike accident and has been paraplegic ever since.

programme.title: Giants of Fortune - The Whale Sharks of Oslob
programme.desc: In the little Filipino village of Oslob on the Cebu Island, people suffer from typhoons and overfishing. Until the world’s biggest fish and the Internet change everything.Fisherman Zosimo’s dearest wish is for his children to graduate from high school one day. Yet the chance that this wish will come true is tiny, since at times Zosimo doesn’t even manage to feed the family. Typhoons and overfishing make the lives of Oslob fishermen difficult.

programme.title: Wild Pacific - The Beauty of Life
programme.desc: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest of Earth's oceanic divisions. It extends from the Arctic Ocean in the north to the Southern Ocean.

programme.title: Mysterious Oceanic Oases - Hotspots of Life
programme.desc: Countless marine animals frolic on the steep slopes of underwater volcanoes. In many cases, several are rare species not found elsewhere. This is in part due to the fact that plankton clings to the wall and provides the fish with food in abundance. This documentary shows several of these oases and also examines the impact dive tourism has and whether preventive measures can help to maintain them. Nature and underwater filmmaker Rolf Möltgen undertakes dives into the mysterious underwater mountain landscapes with marine scientists from all corners of the globe. This journey takes us to Mexico, to snappers, white-tip reef sharks, Galapagos sharks and giant mantas. We visit the Maldives, Colombia and Costa Rica, where the team documents rare species such as deep sea burbots, small tooth sand tiger and dogfish sharks, in depths of more than 3 metres. The eerie underwater mountain world proves: everyone plays a part in the network of life. Thanks to consistent protective regulations, it has been possible to retain the underwater diversity - especially in the unique oases of the high seas

We visit the Maldives, Colombia and Costa Rica, where the team documents rare species such as deep sea burbots, small tooth sand tiger and dogfish sharks, in depths of more than 3 metres. The eerie underwater mountain world proves: everyone plays a part in the network of life. Thanks to consistent protective regulations, it has been possible to retain the underwater diversity - especially in the unique oases of the high seas

programme.title: The Last Paradises: Patagonia - Coast of the Killer Whale

programme.title: Lobsters - The Knights Of The Deep

programme.title: Mantises - Masters of Deception
programme.desc: They are killers. They kill with unbelievable precision. They fight Kung Fu style and are seen in Japan as a symbol of vigilance - the mantises. Their triangular head with its unique flexibility is conspicuous. Two overdimensioned eyes fixate the distance to their prey rapidly and three-dimensionally. The chest segment of the mantis is prolonged and equipped with spiny appendages that can spear their prey as fast as a jack knife. The mysterious aura that surrounds the praying mantis has a lot to do with the fact that they are rarely seen. They have adapted to their surroundings perfectly. No matter whether leaves, blossoms, tree bark, sandy floors or even orchids - the mantis adjusts to all environments.

programme.title: Predators of a Different Kind - In the World of the Unknown Sharks
programme.desc: With the aid of modern technology, reveal the unknown behaviour of some unusual species of shark: lemon sharks and their white-tip reef counterparts. Our film trip begins on the Bahamas. To be more precise: in the turquoise-blue waters of the Grand Bahama Bank, in an exactly fixed location. In the spring, 70 – 80 pregnant lemon sharks arrive here. This huge shark population was first discovered just a few years ago by shark researcher, Professor Sam Gruber. Many of the females are tired and rest on the seabed. Pregnant tiger sharks swim in the midst of this group. Without any protection whatsoever, our cameramen shoot their footage, surrounded by sharks and succeed in capturing images hitherto unseen. We continue our journey to Gainesville, Florida, to meet Gordon Hubbell, the leading shark denture expert with the world’s largest shark denture collection. He knows everything about the evolutionary history of the lemon sharks, in addition to those of the white-tip reef variety off Cocos Island, Costa Rica. Here, we encounter large schools of fish, unprecedented numbers of stingrays, as well as hammerhead sharks. However, it is the white-tip reek sharks that make the biggest impression. Their performance begins late at night. Marauding, they patrol in large groups through the reefs and hunt everything that moves. Scales and dead prey fish float above the reef – a welcoming change of diet for the ubiquitous barracudas.

programme.title: Mysterious Oceanic Oases - Hotspots of Life
programme.desc: Countless marine animals frolic on the steep slopes of underwater volcanoes. In many cases, several are rare species not found elsewhere. This is in part due to the fact that plankton clings to the wall and provides the fish with food in abundance. programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

programme.title: The Fifth Estate
programme.desc: The top-notch team of hosts Bob McKeown, Gillian Findlay, Mark Kelley and Habiba Nosheen provides unique and engaging documentaries from Canada and beyond. "The Fifth Estate" is a reference to the term Fourth Estate, and was chosen to highlight the program's determination to go beyond everyday news into original journalism. The series has won numerous awards for its reporting, including Gemini Awards, International Emmys, the Michener Award, and even an Academy Award for a 1981 episode that was released in theaters the following year. Since September 1975, Canadians have tuned in to experience interesting stories that are always well-crafted and thought-provoking.

Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Bei der Hyperloop-Technologie werden magnetisch angetriebene Transportkapseln durch eine Vakuum-Röhre befördert. Der dadurch wegfallende Luftwiderstand ermöglicht sehr hohe Geschwindigkeiten und nahezu geräuschloses Reisen. Doch von den ersten Pilotprojekten hin zum flächendeckenden Einsatz ist es noch ein weiter Weg.

programme.title: No Limits - Sport Extrem
programme.desc: Extrem-Hindernisrennen liegen nicht erst seit TV-Sendungen wie "Ninja Warrior" voll im Trend. Immer mehr Männer und Frauen gehen mit ihren Körpern ans Limit, suchen darin das Glück. Der wohl beliebteste Lauf ist der "Tough Mudder" mit weltweit 2,5 Millionen Teilnehmern. Der fast 20 Kilometer lange Geländekurs führt durch Matsch und Eiswasser. Wer hier starten will benötigt nicht nur Muskeln.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Felix und Max sind leidenschaftliche Motorradfahrer und lieben die Geschwindigkeit. Heute wollen sie sich diesen Kick auf Borkum ganz ohne Motor geben. Mit der unberechenbaren Kraft des Windes geht es mit einem Kitebuggy über den kilometerlagen Strand. Diese Gefährte erreichen dabei bis zu 100 Kilometer die Stunde. Die beiden haben es sich allerdings leichter vorgestellt, als es tatsächlich ist.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Skiken ist eine nordische Sportart bei der man auf Skiern mit Rollen auch im Sommer die Pisten unsicher machen kann. Allerdings stand John noch nie in seinem Leben auf Skiern, geschweige denn Skikes. Kann Skike-Trainer Erik Kreutzner ihn heute wirklich von seinem Lieblingssport begeistern oder vergeht John so die komplette Lust aufs Skifahren?

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Felix und Max begeben sich auf moderne Schatzsuche. Mit Hilfe von GPS-Koordinaten gilt es "Caches" zu finden, die andere Abenteurer versteckt haben. Im Wald wollen sie einen Multicache finden. Dabei geht es darum, mehrere Verstecke aufzuspüren, um am Ende einen Bonuscache zu entdecken. Um die Aufgabe meistern zu können, beginnt die Schnitzeljagd der Schulfreunde in aller Frühe.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Felix und Max wollen dieses Mal auf das Dach Deutschlands. Ohne Vorbereitung wollen Sie den Gipfel der Zugspitze in fast 3.000 Metern Höhe erklimmen. Den Aufstieg wollen die Abenteurer in zwei Tagen schaffen, doch im hochalpinen Gelände geht ihnen langsam die Puste aus. Zudem macht Max seine Höhenangst mit jedem Meter mehr zu schaffen.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Wing Foil Surfen ist der neue Hype im Wassersport. Auf Norderney wollen Felix und Max diesen Trend im Selbstversuch ausprobieren. Die Österreicherin Evi und der Schotte John wollen heute eine Nacht in luftiger Höhe verbringen. Christian und seine Freundin Jana wollen heute mit Hilfe des Mikroabenteuer-Experten Christo Foerster von der Nordsee bis zur Ostsee laufen.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: In "Bayrisch Kanada" wollen die Naturjunkies John und Evi heute mit einem Stand Up Paddle aufs Wildwasser. Die Berliner Köche Christian und Felix machen eine Fahrradtour auf dem Wasser. Und eine idyllische Ballonfahrt endet heute für Felix und Max im freien Fall. GoKart-Fahren kann jeder - Felix und Max wollen heute eine fahrende Bierkiste bauen.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Die Stuttgarter Felix und Max starten ihr Mikroabenteuer diesmal direkt vor der Haustür. Mit einem Longboard wollen sie mitten auf der Schwäbischen Alb 35 Kilometer zurücklegen. Der Berliner Christian will heute mit seinem Sohn und Freundin Jana ein Floss bauen und das soll die drei am Ende auch noch trocken übers Wasser bringen. Eine idyllische Ballonfahrt endet heute für John im freien Fall.

programme.title: Deutschland Outdoor
programme.desc: Im Erzgebirge haben sich der Mountainbiker Christian und sein bester Freund Til vorgenommen, an zwei Tagen den Bikeman Trail zu bezwingen. Im Allgäu steht John am Abgrund - er testet beim Klippenspringen seinen Mut. Und beim Apnoetauchen im Blindsee erleben Felix und Max einen Tiefenrausch. 15 Meter wollen sie mit nur einem Atemzug bezwingen.

programme.title: Die Schatzsucher von Ischia
programme.desc: Früher fuhren Giulio Lauro und sein Sohn Gaetano aufs Meer, um vor der Küste Ischias Fische zu fangen. Der Erlös reichte kaum zum Leben, das Geschäft lief mit der Zeit immer schlechter. Heute haben die Lauros keine Fische, sondern Touristen an Bord. Denn inzwischen spüren sie in der Bucht vor Ischia Ponte nicht Makrelen und Kalmare, sondern Artefakte der Antike auf.

programme.desc: Marilia's transformative Bali journey unfolded with cultural immersion and healing escapades. Tirta Empul temple brought purification and Wira's guidance. Marilia gathered flowers and spices at Urban Nomads Garden with Janice, who prepared a delightful coconut soup and salad. Marilia met Justin Chea, director of Kechara Soup Kitchen, and volunteered for food preparation and distribution. Filming and reflection took place at Independence Square. The trip ended with relaxation by the pool and a refreshing swim, appreciating the hotel's architecture and views. Marilia's journey in Malaysia was diverse, including animal care, wellness, culinary exploration, volunteerism, and self-reflection, making it truly memorable.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: We journey to India, a land revered for its ancient spiritual wisdom and practices. From the tranquil valleys of Kullu Manali in the Himalayas to the vibrant, bustling streets of Delhi, we explore the multifaceted world of mindfulness, meditation, and yoga. As we navigate through contrasting environments, we discover how meditation is part of daily life, offering invaluable lessons about finding inner tranquility amid external chaos. We also delve into the transformative impact of mindfulness on underprivileged children, highlighting how these ancient practices empower young lives. Rooted in India's rich cultural heritage, the episode reveals how the nation's spiritual traditions provide both sanctuary and a deeper connection to ourselves and the broader world. Join us for this enlightening expedition as we unravel the power of mindfulness and how we can incorporate it into our daily lives no matter where we live.

programme.title: Health Explored
programme.desc: In the emotionally charged episode host Mike honors a deeply personal commitment to his late father, who passed away from cancer, to seek out the true meaning of happiness. Following this heartfelt promise, we venture to Bhutan, a remarkable country where happiness is not merely an emotion, but a national policy ingrained in its culture. From the lively capital of Thimphu to the peaceful farmlands of Punakha, we explore how Bhutan has seamlessly woven well-being into all aspects of life—from its education system that teaches happiness as a subject to its communities that prioritize collective well-being. This journey serves as both a tribute to Mike's father and an investigation into how Bhutan's unique approach to happiness could offer transformative insights for our own lives. Join us on this poignant and enlightening trip to the Land of the Thunder Dragon as we delve into what happiness truly means, fulfilling a promise and enriching our understanding of life's greatest pursuit.

Cala Luna offers a rejuvenating body treatment amidst serene surroundings. We encounter the Maleku Tribes, witnessing their dance ceremony and visiting their cacao farm. The journey concludes with a breath taking hike and a majestic volcano view, reminding us of nature's beauty. This episode is a transformative adventure of self-discovery, cultural immersion, and connection with nature.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Há mais de 40 anos, o Salão Automobilístico de Essen tem sido a feira mundial de esporte motorizado e afinação. É aqui que os sonhos se tornam realidade. O lema da feira deste ano é "Motoristas e Sonhos". Também: Uma comparação: BMW Z4 e Audi RS5 sintonizados pela SKN. E: pintura extrema, jantes cromadas e muitos monitores. Todos os anos, a elite da cena de afinação faz as honras no Prêmio Pirelli Tuning. O vencedor não apenas ganha um troféu, mas também um prêmio em dinheiro de 2.500 euros.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Abt Sportsline significa afinação ao mais alto nível. A empresa sediada em Kempten extrai seu know-how do automobilismo. Não é à toa que seu lema é "Da pista de corrida à estrada". E: mais uma vez, um VW que afirma ser capaz de competir com o maior em cena. O nome: Rohte VW Golf R20. A empresa Rothe gostou da marca VW. O primeiro Golf afinado deles foi há 25 anos.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Lucy Diakovska é hoje uma convidada da Brabus em Bottrop. E ela pode até dar uma mãozinha. E: O MTM Clubsport é o salão da família para a pista de corrida. Mais potência com menos peso. Este RS6 funciona a mais de 350 km/h em estrada aberta. Demasiado rápido para a maioria dos carros super esportivos. O preço para isto - cerca de 160.000 euros. Este Audi é, na verdade, superqualificado para os desvios de neve selvagens.

programme.title: Tuning

Eles transformam um T5 normal no MPV mais dinâmico do mundo. E: O Ferdinand GT3 RS é o Porsche mais lento do mundo. RS, a propósito, significa ciclismo - tem uma potência de 1 a 2 forças humanas. A relação entre potência e peso é de 75 kg por MS.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Dia de Conti Tuning: Desta vez, o lema do Conti Tuning Day é 'Power Limousines' e Lucy dá uma olhada de perto nos carros de corrida. E: Uma McLaren SLR, a obra-prima da Mercedes. O carro super esportivo entre os carros esportivos. Falar de um carro esporte comum seria um eufemismo. Apenas 3500 unidades foram produzidas. Mas esta se destaca ainda mais do número já muito pequeno. Este é o SLR mais caro do mundo.

programme.title: Porsche 550 RS Spyder

programme.title: História do carro
programme.sub-title: Historia do carro - Historia do carro - Land Rover
programme.desc: Robusto, honesto, simples, o Land Rover é o alicerce dos veículos off-road. Construído em 1948 como um simples carro para os agricultores britânicos, o Land Rover logo se tornou um sucesso de exportação. Hoje, o Landy está em casa em todo o mundo, um carro em qualquer lugar, um todo-o-terreno e um todo-terreno.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Vive la diferença: sempre extraordinário no design, sempre incomum no conforto do motor, muitas vezes de vanguarda: os carros da marca Renault. Com o Dauphine, os modelos R4, R16 e R5, a Renault está fazendo história.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Estes são carros com paixão. Desde o início, a Citroën celebrou a alegria da extravagância. Um marco na história automotiva é a Traction Avant, chamada de gangster sedan. O 2 CVS chamado "o pato" é incomum e encantador. O pato se torna um veículo de culto para estudantes, professores e mestres na arte de viver. O DS19, a deusa, parece que veio de outra estrela.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: É o carro da razão, não excitante, mas um mega-vendedor: o VW Golf, o carro de maior sucesso da Europa, 30 milhões de unidades vendidas. O Golfe é compatível com a massa, sem classe e domina a classe compacta. A história do carro mostra a história da geração Golf e revela o segredo de seu sucesso.

programme.title: História do carro
programme.desc: Ninguém é mais rápido, ninguém é mais confiável e ninguém é mais bem-sucedido do que a Porsche Racing. Com mais de 28.000 vitórias em 65 anos, a Porsche estabeleceu um recorde mundial. A História Automotiva conta a história das imbatíveis equipes de corrida de Zuffenhausen. A lenda do rally Walter Röhrl e o vencedor do Le Mans Hans Hermann também comentam sobre o sucesso da Porsche Racing.

programme.title: Put your car on TV

programme.title: Put your car on TV

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Cuando Alejandro y Sol comienzan a entablar una buena relación llegan las malas noticias y Sol debe irse a su pueblo. programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor

Sol lo rechaza delicadamente y Alejandro decide que deben volver y respetar la decisión de ella. Don Eloy le informa a Maricielo que ha pagado la deuda y que la casa donde vive su familia ahora le pertenece. Alicia va a provocar a Carlos a su estudio y luego lo lleva hasta la prisión donde él le informa a su madre que saldrá en libertad.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Reina logra disimular frente a su hijo la conversación que estaba teniendo con el matón encargado de asesinar a Raúla y Sol. Ricarda se despide de las internas del penal ante la atenta mirada de Alicia, quien llevó a Carlos hasta allí. Luego ambos se dirigen a un apartamento de los Monserrat donde Alicia le transfiere una suma considerable de dinero a Carlos y pacta un encuentro en un resort. Ricarda llega a su casa y se encuentra con su hija Giselle que no sabe nada de su estancia en prisión.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Sol afronta la muerte de su madre junto a Alejandro. Ambos se cuestionan las últimas palabras de Raúla. Alejandro va a casa de Columba a avisar de la muerte. Maricielo es la ROKUra en enterarse y acude a acompañar a Sol. Sol le confía los dichos de Raúla y las extrañas circunstancias del accidente. Maricielo sospecha. El que también sospecha es José Domingo de Columba. A pesar de todo, ella concurre al apartamento de Eloy. Ahí charlan sobre la casa y él finalmente la besa.

programme.title: Entre Tu Amor y Mi Amor
programme.desc: Reina se aparece en el velorio de Raúla y finge aprobar la amistad entre Alejandro y Sol. Por detrás, urde un plan junto a Aída. Tras dejar a Columba y a Raquel cerca de su casa para no despertar sospechas, Eloy ve desde su auto a José Domingo y a Nené besándose en la calle. En el entierro, Maricielo no entiende cómo se enteró Eloy y no así Alicia. La desaparición de Carlos le parece sospechosa. Alicia se entera de que Carlos podría padecer de lupus y se ofrece a ir a hacer una interconsulta.

En otro lugar, Víctor Manuel le confiesa a Susy que se ha enamorado de otra mujer. Susy, curiosa de quién puede ser comienza a indagar y finalmente descubre que es de Yolanda de quién se enamoró. programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 127: Gabriel teme perder a Marisela
programme.desc: Gabriel va a ver a su tío Braulio y le dice que cree que ha perdido a Marisela y a sus hijos. Cachita escucha que Isadora es llamada hija por Volcán y la última admite que ambas provienen de una familia de prostitutas. Isabela está conversando con Abril, Luly y Mirna cuando llega Tomás a buscarla para salir, se van y Luly los acompaña. Mientras Abril se queda con Mirna llega una joven por el aviso que han colocado en la prensa. Cachita le pregunta a Volcán de dónde han sacado al bebé que tiene Isadora. Braulio trata de tranquilizar a su sobrino Gabriel. Marisela amamanta a su hijita mientras conversa con su hijo, ella no lo recuerda cuando bebé, Jesús les dice que él le sacaba los gases a Ricardo después de ser amamantado por Marisela.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 128: Jesus terminal, el secreto de Rambo
programme.desc: Gabriel y Tomás le explican a Marisela que Jesús se encuentra en la etapa terminal de su enfermedad. En la Comisaría, Rambo confiesa que el día que murió la esposa del Dr. Núñez, él llevó a Malavé al edificio donde ella vivía. Mientras él lo esperaba se formó un zaperoco porque alguien se había lanzado del edificio. En ese momento bajó Malavé y ambos se fueron de allí. Inocencia va a ver a Abril para preguntarle si ha averiguado algo de su hijo y tras confirmar algunos detalles, ésta le asegura que ya sabe quien tiene a su bebé. Cachita conversa con Volcán acerca del bebé que compró Isadora y le pregunta cómo harán para que las pruebas de ADN indiquen que es hijo de Gabriel.

programme.title: Engañada
programme.sub-title: Enganada - Episodio 129: Pomarrosa es su hija; Isadora no
programme.desc: Gabriel habla con Marisela de las pruebas de ADN que demostraron que Pomarrosa sí es su hija, pero el niño de Isadora no. Yolanda le dice al Padre Juan que, esté donde esté, siempre seguirá siendo su amiga. Aurora se queda con la niña, mientras Marisela y Gabriel se van a la clínica y éste le pide que tenga mucho cuidado sobre todo por Isadora. En la casa hogar le informan a Diego que Yolanda se ha ido y él sale a buscarla desesperado. Isadora le comenta a Flavia que ya no necesita al bebé que compró. Flavia le pide que recapacite, le recuerda las cosas malas que ha hecho y le recomienda que vea a un psiquiatra, pero Isadora sigue obsesionada en su idea de recuperar a Gabriel.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo e Irene tienen una conversación muy seria después de lo que pasó en la empresa. Esa noche, tras regresar de la clínica, donde Irene cuidó a su madre todo el día, Agustina increpa a Leonardo y le recrimina no haberle avisado que no vendría a cenar y que tampoco se haya preocupado por sus hijos. Ya en su dormitorio, Leonardo e Irene hacen el amor por primera vez. Rodrigo y Alejandra se encuentran en un bar. Ella lo desprecia, pero él insiste en que ella finalmente caerá en sus brazos. Esa noche, Rodrigo se acuesta con Altaír. Sin embargo, su marido acusa a Carlos, en su propia casa, de ser el amante.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Asesinan a dos reclusas en la cárcel donde está Virginia. Jimena se entera de esto y va a la cárcel, junto con Carlos Ernesto, quién la sigue, y ella termina confesando que recibió una llamada de alguien que ofrecía asesinar a Virginia. La directora de la cárcel termina deteniendo a Jimena. Felipe va a la casa de los Ferrándiz para avisarle a Irene de lo sucedido en la cárcel y Agustina sorprende a Felipe y a Irene abrazándose. La acusa con Leandro, pero este toma partido por Irene y echa de la casa a Agustina. Ella le pide ayuda a su sobrino Leo ofreciéndole a cambio revelarle un secreto familiar.

programme.title: Amor Secreto
programme.desc: Leonardo visita a Trinidad en la clínica. Ella desconfía de las intenciones de Leonardo y de la familia Ferrándiz en general. Le asegura que su hija, Virginia, es inocente. Leonardo le garantiza que se equivoca, que la situación de Virginia es muy incómoda para todos. Irene, junto con Felipe, van a visitar a Jimena y a Carlos Ernesto. Estos últimos le dicen a Irene que se alegran de que Virginia esté sana y salva por los asesinatos en la prisión. Jimena le asegura a Irene que no es cómplice del hecho. Irene le cree. Leo desconfía de su tía Agustina, la trata de mentirosa. Ella se desespera y le asegura poseer un secreto muy importante. Leo le asegura que nadie la va a echar de la casa. Leo se va y Agustina se dice a ella mismo que si la echan, revelará el secreto.

Logo, os dois se apaixonam, mas por causa de suas vidas distintas, a chance de ficarem juntos é remota. Mesmo assim, eles iniciam um relacionamento pelo qual lutarão com unhas e dentes, mas que também colocará suas vidas em perigo.

programme.title: Pessoa Sombria
programme.desc: Quando um jovem casal se muda para a casa dos seus sonhos, a vida rapidamente se transforma em um pesadelo. Megan é assombrada por figuras sombrias e imagens fantasmagóricas que se tornam cada vez mais reais... e ameaçadoras.

programme.title: O Destino de Grace
programme.desc: Após uma missão, uma enfermeira do exército retorna à fazenda da sua avó em uma comunidade Amish, em Ohio, onde encontra um romance inesperado e é envolvida em um misterioso assassinato.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Após uma grande perda, Roosevelt, aos 25 anos, abandona Nova York para criar gado nas terras sem lei de Dakota.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Roosevelt enfrenta um vizinho poderoso tentando tomar seu rancho Elkhorn em uma disputa traiçoeira de terras.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Acusados de roubo de gado, Roosevelt e seus homens precisam capturar o ladrão para salvar a reputação do Rancho Elkhorn.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Na caçada a ladrões de cavalos, Theodore Roosevelt aprende que a justiça na fronteira nem sempre é justa.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Com a saúde afetada, Theodore Roosevelt é levado a uma Vila Sioux para buscar cura antes que seja tarde demais.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Theodore Roosevelt inicia uma caçada nas Montanhas Bighorn, no Wyoming, onde se encontra cara a cara com um urso pardo que devora homens.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Theodore Roosevelt e seus homens caçam um bandido mascarado que aterroriza as linhas de carruagens em Medora.

programme.title: Elkhorn
programme.desc: Theodore Roosevelt se recusa a vender seu gado ao fundador da cidade e desencadeia uma cadeia de eventos violentos.

programme.title: Rastros do Além
programme.desc: Um cataclismo que rompe as barreiras entre o mundo e o próximo deixou "Remanescentes": fantasmas dos mortos que se tornam parte da vida cotidiana. Após 9 anos de convivência silenciosa com os vivos, um Remanescente ameaça uma adolescente, levando-a a uma missão que mudará o curso de sua vida para sempre.

programme.title: Esquadrão Antissequestro
programme.desc: Gabriela (Gabriela Simoni), uma menina de onze anos, filha de um jogador de futebol, é sequestrada durante a Copa do Mundo por um grupo de terroristas.

programme.title: Life - Um Retrato de James Dean
programme.desc: Inspirada pela ensaio fotográfico para a revista Life (1995), revela a amizade impossível entre fotógrafo Dennis Stock e um ator pouco conhecido chamado James Dean. Naquele momento Stock tinha 26 anos e, aparece James Dean, uma estrela em ascensão, um homem que vai mudar a cultura popular de ternos pelos jeans e de ídolos de matinê por quebra-cabeças e adolescents rebeldes.

programme.title: Guerra ao Terror
programme.desc: Durante a Guerra do Iraque, um sargento recém-designado para um esquadrão antibombas do exército entra em conflito com seus companheiros de esquadrão devido à sua maneira peculiar de lidar com o trabalho.

programme.title: A Verdadeira História de Ned Kelly
programme.desc: Inspirado no best-seller de Peter Carey, este filme coloca em questão toda a mitologia criada ao redor do mito sobre a vida de Ned Kelly, observando o passado de violência de toda uma sociedade. Acompanhamos a juventude de Ned e observamos sua vida até o final, percebendo, sob a ótica do protagonista, o quanto é distorcida a fina linha que separa o certo do errado. As motivações de Kelly são reveladas e as tragédias em torno de sua gangue são mostradas de forma intensa e poderosa, a começar pelo amor de uma mãe por seu filho.

programme.title: Tráfico de Mulheres
programme.desc: Nesta história inspirada em personagens reais, três garotas dos EUA, Nigéria e Índia são traficadas por meio de uma elaborada rede global e escravizadas em um bordel no Texas, e devem juntas tentar uma fuga ousada para retomar sua liberdade.

programme.title: Código da Máfia
programme.desc: Mike acaba de sair da prisão e aceita fazer um último serviço com seu irmão para poder se livrar do mundo do crime e cuidar de sua filha. Ele logo descobrirá que a justiça das ruas é muito pior que tudo o que passou na prisão.

programme.title: O Justiceiro
programme.desc: Mestre em artes marciais e lutador, Kung Wei, vive numa casa humilde, com a esposa que está muito doente e com Johnny, seu filho que o adora e segue seus ensinamentos morais e de artes marciais. Kung Wei, é "recrutado" sigilosamente pela polícia, para disfarçado, desmantelar uma quadrilha em Hong Kong. Enquanto trabalhava com outra identidade, seu filho sofria com seus colegas que chamavam o pai de "bandido"; pois, a ele imputavam um crime. Neste meio tempo, sua esposa morre. Antes de morrer, ela confia a guarda do pequeno Johnny, ao policial que "investigava" Kung, supondo que se marido fosse um bandido perigoso. O mestre Kung Wei, terá que lutar muito nessa missão!

programme.title: Roubo a Máfia
programme.desc: Um casal especializado em roubar da máfia começa um trabalho tão grande que os torna alvos tanto da máfia quanto do FBI.

programme.title: Skin Traffik
programme.desc: Traumatizado pela morte de um inocente, Bradley, um assassino de aluguel, se isola da sociedade e vaga pelas ruas perigosas de um gueto pobre da cidade em busca de um sentido para sua vida.

programme.title: Departamento Q: Guardiões das Causas Perdidas
programme.desc: Após um tiroteio que deixou um de seus parceiros morto e outro paralítico, o detetive Carl é designado para o Departamento Q, um novo departamento para casos antigos e arquivados, composto apenas por ele e seu assistente.

programme.title: End Game: Roubo de Identidade
programme.desc: Um é um assassino implacável, o outro é um ator desconhecido. Uma súbita reviravolta do destino, tarde demais para voltar atrás. Duas vidas trocadas os trouxeram para uma vida milagrosa!

programme.desc: Um homem de meia idade em um casamento estagnado descobre que sua vida está em suspenso quando uma jovem atraente e seu marido aparentemente abusivo se mudam na porta ao lado.

programme.title: Greta
programme.desc: Greta é uma adolescente rebelde e com tendências suicidas que, após o divórcio de sua mãe, é enviada para o verão com seus avós em Nova Jersey, onde sua vida é de um voo inesperado ao enamorar de um cozinheiro com um passado complicado.

programme.title: Apenas Por Uma Noite
programme.desc: O marido de uma mulher casada e com uma vida perfeita trai a irmã, com consequências extremas para todos.

programme.title: Receitas do Amor
programme.desc: Depois de uma crítica negativa e uma palestra do chef Gordon Ramsay, um talentoso mas angustiado chef londrino transforma um pub country em um restaurante gourmet.

programme.title: A Árvore Da Vida
programme.desc: O jovem Jack é um dos três irmãos que cresceram como parte da família O'Brien em uma pequena cidade do Texas. Jack tem um relacionamento controverso com seu pai, mas se dá bem com sua bela mãe. Como adulto, Jack luta com seu passado e tenta dar sentido à sua infância, ao mesmo tempo em que se debate com questões existenciais maiores.

programme.title: Quem Quer Ser Um Milionário?
programme.desc: Um adolescente de Mumbai reflete sobre sua vida depois de ser acusado de enganar a versão indiana de "Quem quer ser um milionário?"

programme.title: Carol
programme.desc: Duas mulheres de origens diferentes começam uma relação na década de 1950. Carol é casada, mas seu casamento está morto há muito tempo. Ela quer um divórcio, mas o marido está tentando desesperadamente manter as aparências. Quando Carol (Cate Blanchett) e Teresa (Mia Wasikowska) se apaixonam, o marido de Carol inicia o processo para obter a custódia total de seu filho. Seu marido tenta usar a homosexualidade de Carol no tribunal contra ela e lhe proíbe de ver sua filha por pelo menos 3 meses em uma tentativa de vingança

programme.desc: Um professor universitário alcoólatra em recuperação conhece uma nova aluna sedutora. Ela oferece a ele uma fuga sensual da realidade até que ele perceba que ela pode ser louca.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. Sonic purposely allows his own capture as well, but does not expect to be placed in a maximum-security jail cell. With Robotnik angrily sends Sonic in the cell for interfering with his plans once again.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind
programme.desc: While Scratch and Grounder try to catch Sonic using a Suction plate, two aliens, one being a prince, crash lands on Mobius. Sonic meets the prince when he finds out that the prince's baby brother would blow up Mobius which Sonic must save.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. However, the machine backfires, and enlarges Tails instead in nearby Wienerville. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. Robotnik sends Scratch and Grounder after Tails, who defends himself the best he can with Home Alone booby traps for Scratch and Grounder. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's attempt to turn Sonic into an old man with his newest device backfires, turning him and Tails, and later himself, into babies. Now stuck in a day-care, the infantile Sonic and Tails must try to keep Robotnik under control, while Scratch and Grounder attempt to get him back.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. But when Robotnik Jr. meets Sonic, he becomes a naturalist and teams up with Sonic to thwart Robotnik's evil scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik invents an electron altering generator which makes Scratch and Grounder twice as fast as Sonic. When they lose it and Tails picks it up, Tails speeds through the Mobius countryside leaving disasters and accidents in his wake. Seeing this, Robotnik convinces the villagers that the little fox belongs in jail, and Tails is forced to flee. With Tails all alone, Scratch and Grounder attack, and Sonic makes a last minute rescue.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik captures a Kangaroo named MacHopper, and uses his brain-wipe-reprogramming-computer to transform him into a resourceful demolitions expert (Ala MacGiver). But Mac escapes before Robotnik installs the final Get Sonic program, and teams up with Sonic and Tails to BLAST Robotnik.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. Through a blunder by the robots, all are stranded in space, and Robotnik tries to blow all of them out of the stars. Sonic builds a rocket out of S and G's spare parts, and all return to Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: This week is a good one, can you feel the energy? I’m shaking because it’s Poland, it’s powerful, it’s strongman champions league, and you know what I'm going to say, get ready because it’s about to get heavy.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: It’s time to show our strength and gain respect from the gods of Olympus. Our gladiators have many events set out by no other than Hercules himself. programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: The only and official world championship Truckpulling for its 10th year, again at the Strongman Champions league. With the 3 times Worldchampion Kelvin de Ruiter – defending his title. This championship has trucks in all shapes and sizes which is a lot like our athletes, there all different pay loads, but does the biggest win or is it the strongest.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League
programme.desc: Years and years of determination has brought us here today, when all the walls felt like they were caving in perseverance. When their bodies were screaming, hurting, shouting stop, beneath. These are the things which make up a man, these are the things that bring you world finalists. This episode they fight for the greatest title of all, they fight to put their names in the history books forever.

programme.title: Strongman Champions League

programme.title: O Som da Música
programme.desc: Em “O Som da Música”, Jacarelvis e seus amigos apresentam as características e sons de diversos instrumentos musicais pertencentes a diferentes culturas. Cada episódio é dedicado a algum instrumento específico, onde são apresentados brevemente a história, os atributos e funcionamento de instrumentos como o violão, o xilofone, a gaita, piano, flauta, entre outros. E a festa sonora fica por conta de Jacarelvis e seus amigos, que apresentam as suas habilidades musicais com cada um dos instrumentos.

programme.title: O Mago das Formas
programme.desc: Viaje para um mundo mágico onde o simpático Mago das Formas revela os segredos dos desenhos! Em cada episódio, três novos desenhos são criados usando formas geométricas básicas e elementos surpresa. Desafios de atenção e curiosidades tornam essa série divertida e educativa, ensinando o conceito de desenho por meio de formas geométricas. Divirta-se e aprenda com o Mago das Formas!

programme.title: Jacarevis e Amigos

A equipe profissional de produção musical garante melodias de alta qualidade, arranjos cativantes e interpretações vocais impecáveis, proporcionando um verdadeiro banquete audiovisual para as crianças. O conteúdo é positivo, divertido e pensado para ajudar as crianças a aprenderem e explorarem o mundo de forma apropriada para sua idade. programme.title: Full Strut
programme.sub-title: "Two Gobblers Down For Nate & Cole | Kansas Turkey Hunt"
programme.desc: Nate heads out for a quick run-and-gun hunt (with his bow) and it doesn’t take long for things to happen. A gobbler works his way in, struts around the decoys, and eventually gives Nate the shot opportunity he was looking for. A couple days later Cole is up to bat. Right off the roost a gobbler commits and the hunt comes together fast with a close-range archery shot. It was a fun few days chasing Kansas gobblers and this trip gave us a few hunts we won’t forget.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.sub-title: "Summer Farm Work, Deer Season is Coming!!"
programme.desc: On this episode of Hunting Land Man Season 3, Slade puts in some early summer farm work to Ensure his target bucks are well fed! Slade also Talks about his Target buck for the year, "Pope"! Slade is laying the trap early in hopes "Pope" makes a mistake early!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode Slade travels to Kansas to try and bag one of the Midwest's most impressive deer!

programme.title: Shoshone Adventures
programme.sub-title: "Nevada Elk: Kings of the High Country"
programme.desc: Elk are the true kings of the high country—and this Nevada hunt proves why. From thin air and brutal climbs to long-range shots and split-second decisions, this is elk hunting at its rawest. Shoshone clients Ryan and his father-in-law Mike travel from Texas to chase world-class bulls in some of the most unforgiving terrain in the West. Limited tags, giant genetics, and no room for mistakes.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.

programme.title: Wildbound by Forloh
programme.desc: In part 2 of the British episodes, Andy visits the majestic land of Scotland. Here he is introduced to Scottish deer stalking, a type of hunting that is full of history and etiquette. He hunts ‘monarch’ stags and goes into the Atlantic waters to find some of the freshest shellfish on the planet which he, and Mike Robinson cook and eat. Concluding the British episodes in a place as wild as Scotland really sets the tone for the series.

programme.title: Huntstand Presents
programme.desc: Massive wildfires had consumed thousands of acres across the Bighorn Mountains and the neighboring foothills. Would the annual HuntStand pronghorn camp be a total bust, or would the crew be able to find a few animals beyond the smoke?

programme.title: The WoodHaven Way
programme.desc: WoodHaven's Phillip Vanderpool pulls off one of the most incredible hunts of his career — taking down “Cyclops,” a 187” Kansas typical buck! This self-filmed hunt has it all: calling, decoying, and a shot from the ground. Watch as Phillip puts all his skills to the test and brings down one of his biggest bucks ever, completely captured on camera.

programme.title: Rocky Mountain Elk Foundation
programme.desc: “Part of our responsibility as citizens in this country is to make sure we not only take care of these resources but we hand it off to the next generation in better condition that we found it.” -Bob Ziehmer, Senior Director of Conservation for Bass Pro Shops & Cabela's Join Bob in New Mexico as he talks about taking care of our natural resources for future generations. Special thanks to Express UU Bar Ranch

programme.title: Pure Hunting
programme.desc: This Montana Wall Tent Turkey hunt has been happening for over 10 years. The cast of characters has slightly changed year to year, but the core group has pretty much stayed the same. Often it has been non-traditional tactics that got birds killed and this year was no exception for Willi.

programme.title: Pure Hunting
programme.desc: Willi and Chris are back in New Mexico, bowhunting elk. Willi made a poor shot on a bull, and after discovering the cause of the poor shot, he hopes to get redemption as their hunting days come to a close.

programme.title: Hard Truths of Conservation
programme.desc: Establishing themselves just after the last Ice Age, the blacktail of Vancouver Island offers an important genetic population isolated from the mainland. To explore the local relationship with the species, its harvesting, conservation and history, Dan Cabela travels to the island.

programme.desc: 2 down, 1 to go. Anthony Virga’s the next man up for a gobbler with Michael Pitts and Matt Garger in New York’s Adirondack Mountains.
